Second Gay Sex Tape Allegedly Filmed In U.S. Capitol: Report
By
Ryan Saavedra
•
Dec 20, 2023
DailyWire.com
•
Facebook
X
Mail
Getty Images
Another sex tape was allegedly filmed inside the
U.S. Capitol
, which comes after news broke last week about an aide for Sen. Ben Cardin (D-MD) who allegedly filmed a sex video involving himself and an unidentified man inside a Senate committee hearing room.
Semafor
reported
on Wednesday that an investigation was launched in June 2022 into a senior aide who worked for Rep. Dan Newhouse (R-WA) over reports of “purported, unbecoming behavior.”
The senior aide, whom the publication decided to not name, denied that he was in the videos and said that he was informed by the congressman that the investigation found “no evidence to the allegation.”
The publication said that it was “clear” though that there was “in fact, a second set of Capitol sex videos, which circulated on Snapchat last year.”
The publication said that it was provided with recordings from a source that showed “a man masturbating inside a House office building, which was identifiable by standard Capitol House furniture and carpeting.”
“The desk at which the videographer performed also held a branded congressional mouse pad,” the report added. “A screenshot of a second video obtained by Semafor shows two men engaged in a sex act in an office setting. The participants’ faces are not visible in any of the material viewed by Semafor.”

A spokesperson for Newhouse said that once their office was alerted about one of their staffers being suspected of being involved in the video, they “immediately contacted the appropriate House entities to conduct an independent investigation.”
They said that they would “not be providing further comment on personnel matters.”
